caption: The video captures a white-walled dance studio with light wood floor, ceiling track lighting, an upper-left air-conditioning unit, and a full-height mirror on the right wall. A female dancer in a black sleeveless top, pleated mini-skirt, and thigh-high boots stands with her back to the camera, facing the mirror. Her front appears as a reflection, and the mirror-side arm extends outward toward the glass. It bends upward near her shoulder and head, then lowers again while her hair swings sharply. Motion blur appears around the hair as her torso and hips rotate. Her stance then widens, and the reflection shows a hand raised near her mouth, while the back view shows the arm bent forward. The mirror reproduces every movement in real time, confirming the facing figure is not another person. The camera and background remain fixed throughout, framing an ongoing gestural sequence.
